name: QQueue Core Self-Hosted Email Platform
free_limit: AGPL-3.0 self-hosted QQueue Core email platform with transactional SMTP integrations, campaigns, queues, workers, templates, contacts, sender identities, DKIM, webhooks and dashboard; no vendor-enforced software quota or expiry is documented.
watch_out: Early beta; complete upstream security/launch checklist before production. Requires your own VPS (at least 2 GB RAM), Docker, domain/DNS, PostgreSQL, Redis, storage and SMTP provider credentials; infrastructure, outbound mail, sending limits and deliverability may incur separate costs. QQueue Cloud is a distinct managed offering and not included.
